issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 01 requests the names and internet addresses (url) of all zoos AND the name and Regierungsbezirk of the respective Gemeinde. The provided solution query (aufgabe01.sql) only selects the zoo name and url and does not include the Gemeinde.name or Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk, so it does not fulfill the task. This mismatch will confuse students because the solution is expected to show the municipality name and district as required by the task but omits them.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution query to select the requested municipality fields as well, for example: SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url AS Internetadresse, Gemeinde.name AS Gemeinde_name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk FROM Zoo, Gemeinde WHERE Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel
